model_annotation:
This image contains two line charts that both display BLEU scores on their respective y-axes, each examining the effect of a different hyperparameter.

The left chart shows BLEU score as a function of the parameter α. The x-axis is labeled "α" with a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 0.9, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2 (0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9). The y-axis is labeled "BLEU" with a linear scale ranging from 28.0 to 28.5, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. A single blue line with circular markers connects five data points. The line begins at approximately 27.95 at α = 0.1, rises to approximately 28.2 at α = 0.3, continues upward to a peak of approximately 28.3 at α = 0.5, then drops to approximately 28.1 at α = 0.7, and further decreases to approximately 28.05 at α = 0.9.

The right chart shows BLEU score as a function of the parameter p. The x-axis is labeled "p" with a linear scale ranging from 0.05 to 0.45, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1 (0.05, 0.15, 0.25, 0.35, 0.45). The y-axis is labeled "BLEU" with a linear scale ranging from 28.0 to 28.5, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. A single blue line with circular markers connects five data points. The line starts at approximately 28.3 at p = 0.05, rises sharply to a peak of approximately 28.4 at p = 0.15, then decreases to approximately 28.2 at p = 0.25, remains near 28.2 at p = 0.35, and drops further to approximately 28.1 at p = 0.45.
